description: The Deluxe 7 is everything an urban commuter could ask for and more. The light weight 6061 alloy frame features an upright position for confident handling in traffic and a stepthrough design for easy mounts and dismounts while the SR Suntour suspension fork and fat 700x40c tires takes the sting out of rough roads. Low maintenance Shimano 7 speed internal hub handles the shifting duties while full fenders and pant guard help keep road spray and grease at bay. There's even a sturdy rear cargo rack, convenient kickstand and lighting system with dynamo hub for worry-free night time commutes.
